segments.speaker: Geert Wilders
segments.text: 26 maart ko, wo boonka Gerrit Wilder, nederland me boonk raha tha, ke Jalali pe pabandi lagai jae, ise jail me dala jae. Per 26 ko, usne tweet kia, ke Jalali ka mere barene wajib ul-qatal hone ka fatwa hai. Wo Gerrit Wilder, disne khake bana mere Nabi alayhis salam ke, keitae, mujhe raton ko neem nahi aati. Mene jawab me kaha, mera fatwa final hai. 26 maart ko, usne tobara.

segments.speaker: Geert Wilders
segments.text: Mujh par pabandiyon ka mutalba kiya. Aur 30 maarch ko udhar unke beli pabandiyan laga rahe the. Aur kuch un pabandiyon pe khush ho rahe the. Dekho batil sara to ek hi hai. Agarche Iran aur Najat me bazaar jang hai. Magar mere masele me to ek hai. Batil batil ke saad mix hai. Garrett Witter aur Najat aur tum apas me ek hai. Allah ka fazal hai ke hamne sab ko joote ki loog pe raka hoa.
